streamFinalMismatch.sourceMechanism: ACP handles raw TextDelta by setting saw_text=true. AgentEvent::End emits settled text only when should_emit_end_text(saw_text, text), currently !saw_text && !text.is_empty(). The raw stream therefore prevents delivery of the changed settled fallback. Renderer parses DSML into a tool row and strips the protocol from prose.
